title: 2X PEG
author: Jacquelina.Woods
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bycgpstw
materials: 200 g PEG-20000 Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #81275-1KG , or equivalent

steps.title: Store solution at room temperature
steps.instruction: Keep the prepared 2X PEG solution at room temperature, protected from light.

steps.title: Dissolve components in water
steps.instruction: In approximately 700 mL deionized or ultrapure water, add 34.8 g Sodium Chloride (Fisher Scientific Catalog #S271 or equivalent) and any other listed components, then heat to 50 °C (recommended) and stir until fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Measure ~700 mL deionized or ultrapure water.
Heat the mixture to 50 °C to aid dissolution.
Stir until all solids are completely dissolved.

steps.title: Adjust final volume to 1 L
steps.instruction: Bring the total solution volume up to 1 L with additional deionized or ultrapure water.
